description: Would you tango with a robot? Inviting us into the fascinating world of dancing machines, robot choreographer Catie Cuan highlights why teaching robots to move with grace, intention and emotion is essential to creating AI-powered machines we will want to welcome into our daily lives. Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.
classificationReason: Directly examines how robots learn graceful, intentional, and socially acceptable movement.
qualityReason: Focused expert talk centered on a specific embodied-robotics problem.
